title: Resume guidance in a later driver call without recursive callbacks
narrative: Frontier and other MCP-capable clients cannot reenter a model session during a pending tool call. Guidance therefore returns as an ordinary tool result; the same driving session calls resume later with the answer. Tracks R-IOC-SESSION[^insp-ioc-03].
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator.start` returns a committed `GraphYield`; `resume` is a separate operation with `expected_sequence`. No recursive callback into an outstanding tool call is required. MCP mapping is documented for M2 (`fangore_insp_mcp_graph_driver`).
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_session_resume`. Hard expects start advice_requested, resume completed, distinct sequences.
